arguments.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
# FY1929-1942 Individual income tax receipts (net of refunds)
# from 1942 Treasury Bulletin page 76, "Individual" column, in thousands of dollars
individual_tax_thousands = {
    1929: 1095541,
    1930: 1146845,
    1931: 833648,
    1932: 427191,
    1933: 352573,
    1934: 419509,
    1935: 527113,
    1936: 674416,
    1937: 1091741,
    1938: 1286312,
    1939: 1028834,
    1940: 982017,
    1941: 1417655,
    1942: 3262800,
}

# Convert to billions: divide by 1,000,000 (thousands -> millions -> billions)
years = sorted(individual_tax_thousands.keys())
receipts_billions = [individual_tax_thousands[y] / 1_000_000 for y in years]

print("Data (year, receipts in billions):")
for y, r in zip(years, receipts_billions):
    print(f"  FY{y}: {r:.6f} billion")

# OLS regression: y = a + b*x
# where y = receipts in billions, x = year
n = len(years)
xbar = sum(years) / n
ybar = sum(receipts_billions) / n

print(f"\nn = {n}")
print(f"Sum of years = {sum(years)}")
print(f"xbar = {xbar}")
print(f"ybar = {ybar}")

# slope = sum((x-xbar)*(y-ybar)) / sum((x-xbar)^2)
numerator = sum((years[i] - xbar) * (receipts_billions[i] - ybar) for i in range(n))
denominator = sum((years[i] - xbar)**2 for i in range(n))
slope = numerator / denominator
intercept = ybar - slope * xbar

print(f"\nOLS regression: y = {intercept:.6f} + {slope:.6f} * x")
print(f"  slope = {slope:.10f}")
print(f"  intercept = {intercept:.10f}")

# Project to FY2000
x_project = 2000
y_project = intercept + slope * x_project
print(f"\nProjected FY2000 (year=2000): {y_project:.6f} billion")

# Actual FY2000 net individual income tax receipts from 2001 bulletin
# Table FFO-2, "Net (4)" column, in millions
actual_fy2000_millions = 1004461
actual_fy2000_billions = actual_fy2000_millions / 1000
print(f"Actual FY2000: {actual_fy2000_billions:.6f} billion")

# Difference: actual - projected
diff = actual_fy2000_billions - y_project
print(f"\nDifference (actual - projected): {diff:.6f} billion")

# Round to nearest tenths
diff_rounded = round(diff, 1)
print(f"Rounded to nearest tenths: {diff_rounded}")

EOF
